modules.module_title: Understanding the Craft and Its Value

pcs.pc_description: Discuss the cultural and economic significance of Moonjh craft in traditional and modern markets.
Recognise the increasing demand for eco- friendly, handmade products and their importance in environmental sustainability.
Explain how craftsmanship, durability, and innovative designs help build a loyal customer base.
Identify emerging trends in Moonjh craft, including new product applications and evolving consumer preferences.
Identify high-quality Moonjh grass suitable for different products and ensure ethical and sustainable sourcing.
Demonstrate proper techniques for cleaning, sorting, and drying Moonjh grass to maintain its strength and flexibility.
Perform soaking and softening processes effectively to prepare Moonjh grass for weaving.
Show how to handle and store raw materials properly to prevent spoilage, mould, or pest infestation.
Demonstrate various traditional and contemporary weaving patterns used in baskets, mats, decorative items, etc.
Perform accurate cutting, shaping, and assembling techniques to ensure uniform and visually appealing products.
Show how to reinforce weaving structures to improve durability and product lifespan.
Implement innovative weaving techniques to create unique, high-value products that attract modern consumers.

modules.module_title: Product Specification in Moonjh Product Making

pcs.pc_description: Describe the key materials used in Moonjh product making, including natural Moonjh grass, cotton or jute threads, natural dyes, etc. ensuring sustainability and durability in products like baskets, mats, trays, and coasters.
Identify the standard dimensions, weight, and size variations of Moonjh products such as storage baskets, decorative trays, and floor mats, considering functionality and customer preferences.

Explain the different weaving techniques used in Moonjh craft, highlighting traditional patterns and methods that enhance strength and aesthetics in products like handwoven wall hangings, table mats, fruit baskets, etc.
Discuss the significance of surface finish, colour variations, and natural treatments in improving the quality and appeal of Moonjh products, including planters, lampshades, laundry baskets, etc.
Identify common quality issues such as uneven weaving, weak joints, or rough edges, and apply corrective measures.
Demonstrate finishing techniques, such as trimming, smoothing, and decorative enhancements, to improve product quality.
Show how to apply natural dyes or protective coatings to enhance product durability and aesthetic appeal.
Recognise the importance of proper storage to prevent moisture damage, discolouration, or pest attacks.
Demonstrate appropriate packaging techniques to protect Moonjh craft products during transportation and storage.
Show safe handling methods to prevent breakage or damage to delicate woven items.
Perform labelling and branding techniques to make products easily identifiable and more appealing to customers.
Ensure all finished products meet quality standards before they are packed and dispatched for sale or delivery.
Explain the importance of regular maintenance and proper storage of tools to ensure longevity and efficiency in Moonjh craft making.
Identify common tools used in Moonjh craft, such as scissors, knives, wooden moulds, and weaving needles, and discuss best practices for their upkeep.
Discuss cleaning techniques for different tools, including removing dirt, sharpening blades, and preventing rust or wear to maintain functionality.
Identify eco-friendly and cost-effective methods for repairing and preserving tools, reducing waste and improving sustainability.
